title: Create Rust workspace
description: Create a new Rust project for the network watcher CLI.

title: Add basic CLI argument parsing
description: Add commands like scan, watch, dns, proxy, and sessions.

title: Create config file support
description: Load config from a local TOML file for paths, ports, logging, and watch settings.
acceptance_criteria: App can read custom config path

title: Read active TCP connections from Linux procfs
description: Parse Linux connection data from procfs and extract local address, remote address, port, protocol, and state.

title: Map sockets to process IDs
description: Inspect process file descriptors and map socket inodes back to owning PIDs.

title: Map process IDs to app metadata
description: Resolve PID to process name, executable path, command line, and user.
acceptance_criteria: Connections show executable path where available

title: Print a table of current connections
description: Render current connections in a readable terminal table.
acceptance_criteria: scan command prints a readable table
Columns can fit common terminal widths

title: Add filtering by process name
description: Allow users to filter visible connections by process name or command substring.
acceptance_criteria: User can filter for chrome or other apps

title: Add filtering by port and protocol
description: Allow users to filter by port, remote port, and TCP or UDP.

title: Implement polling watch loop
description: Poll active connections repeatedly and detect new and closed connections.

title: Create connection event model
description: Represent connection_opened, connection_closed, and connection_seen events consistently.
acceptance_criteria: Events include process and connection metadata

title: Display live connection events
description: Print live events as they happen in the terminal.

title: Add SQLite storage
description: Create a local SQLite database for connection events, processes, DNS observations, and proxy sessions.

title: Persist connection events
description: Write connection events into SQLite for later inspection.
acceptance_criteria: Events can be queried by time range

title: Add sessions
description: Group events into named sessions so an agent run can be inspected later.
acceptance_criteria: User can start a named session
Events are linked to the active session

title: Observe DNS activity
description: Capture DNS lookups so IP addresses can be correlated with domain names.
acceptance_criteria: Domain to IP mappings are saved with timestamps

title: Correlate connections with DNS history
description: Use recent DNS observations to guess which domain a remote IP belongs to.
acceptance_criteria: Connections show probable domain when known

title: Show confidence for domain correlation
description: Mark domain matches as exact, likely, weak, or unknown based on timing and ambiguity.
acceptance_criteria: Ambiguous mappings are not presented as certain

title: Build basic HTTP proxy listener
description: Run a local proxy server that accepts plain HTTP requests.
acceptance_criteria: Plain HTTP requests can pass through

title: Forward plain HTTP requests
description: Forward incoming HTTP requests to their destination and return the response to the client.
acceptance_criteria: Response status and headers are preserved

title: Log HTTP requests and responses
description: Capture method, URL, headers, body size, response status, and response body size.

title: Add body capture limits
description: Avoid storing huge request or response bodies by applying configurable size limits.
acceptance_criteria: Stored records show when truncation happened

title: Add secret redaction
description: Redact obvious secrets from headers and bodies before saving logs.
acceptance_criteria: Common API key patterns are redacted

title: Support HTTPS CONNECT tunnelling
description: Handle HTTPS CONNECT requests without decrypting traffic yet.
acceptance_criteria: HTTPS traffic can pass through proxy
Destination host and port are logged

title: Launch a command through the proxy
description: Add a wrapper command that starts another process with HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY set.
acceptance_criteria: User can run a command through watcher
The spawned process is linked to a session

title: Create Claude Code runner command
description: Add a convenience command for launching Claude Code through the local proxy.

title: Create local certificate authority
description: Generate and store a local CA certificate for HTTPS interception experiments.

title: Document trusting the local CA
description: Write clear instructions for trusting the local CA on the test machine or inside the agent environment.
acceptance_criteria: Instructions are specific to Linux first

title: Generate certificates per target domain
description: When intercepting HTTPS, dynamically create a certificate for the requested domain signed by the local CA.

title: Implement HTTPS man-in-the-middle flow
description: Decrypt HTTPS traffic for explicitly proxied clients by terminating TLS locally and creating a second TLS connection upstream.
acceptance_criteria: Intercepted HTTPS requests can be read

title: Restrict HTTPS interception to allowlisted domains
description: Only decrypt traffic for configured domains such as specific AI provider endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown domains are tunnelled, not decrypted

title: Restrict HTTPS interception to launched sessions
description: Only intercept traffic from processes launched by the watcher wrapper command.

title: Store captured agent HTTP payloads
description: Persist intercepted request and response metadata, headers, and bodies for agent sessions.
acceptance_criteria: Captured payloads are linked to sessions

title: Add request detail view in CLI
description: Allow the user to inspect a specific captured request from the terminal.
acceptance_criteria: User can list requests in a session
User can view one request and response

title: Add JSON export for sessions
description: Export a session, including connections and captured requests, as JSON.

title: Create TUI skeleton
description: Build a terminal UI with sections for live connections, sessions, requests, and details.

title: Add live connections screen
description: Show active and recent connections in the TUI.
acceptance_criteria: Connections update while TUI is open
Rows show process, domain, IP, and port

title: Add sessions screen
description: Show saved monitoring sessions and allow opening one.

title: Add request inspector screen
description: Show captured agent requests and responses in a readable TUI view.

title: Add tests for parsers
description: Test procfs parsing, DNS mapping logic, config parsing, and HTTP metadata parsing.

title: Add structured logging
description: Log internal events in a structured format for debugging the watcher itself.

title: Write threat model notes
description: Write a short document explaining what the tool captures, what it refuses to capture, and how secrets are protected.

title: Investigate macOS connection visibility
description: Explore what can be implemented on macOS without privileged Network Extension work.
acceptance_criteria: Document viable macOS APIs or commands

title: Implement basic macOS scan mode
description: Add a best-effort macOS scan command for active connections and process mapping.
acceptance_criteria: scan works on macOS where permissions allow

title: Create Rust TUI kanban project
description: Create a small Rust TUI app that can read task JSONL files.

title: Define task JSONL schema
description: Define the fields the task manager expects, including id, project, epic, title, status, priority, depends_on, tags, and acceptance_criteria.

title: Load tasks from JSONL
description: Read a JSONL file and parse each line into a task model.

title: Render kanban columns
description: Display tasks grouped by status in terminal columns.
acceptance_criteria: Todo, doing, blocked, and done columns render

title: Add keyboard navigation
description: Allow moving between tasks and columns using keyboard shortcuts.

title: Add task detail panel
description: Show full task description, dependencies, tags, and acceptance criteria for the selected task.

title: Update task status from TUI
description: Allow changing a task status and saving back to JSONL.

title: Add dependency warnings
description: Warn when a task is moved to doing while dependencies are not done.

title: Add filtering by project and epic
description: Allow viewing only tasks from one project or one epic.

title: Add import command
description: Add a CLI command that imports or validates a JSONL task file before opening the TUI.
